changelog: Native .gravent Chat Sharing & Trajectory Format: Export conversations natively as .gravent archives with direct save to Downloads/Gravent/Exports
Dual Compatibility: Full backwards compatibility for importing and resuming legacy .antigem and .jsonl.antigem chat files
System Intent Associations: Registered .gravent, .jsonl.gravent, and .antigem file extensions with Android system share and file viewer intents
Seamless Workspace Association: Added dual configuration discovery for ~/.gravent/projects.json and ~/.antigem/projects.json alongside auto-discovery in ~/projects
